comparison.objective: Tune and lock a damper, then operate a guarded impact fixture vs stop a grinder and wait for wheel run-down before retrieving a part.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-bit engagement, torque control, collar manipulation, reacquisition, and iterative cycling vs STOP-button actuation, temporal waiting, and safe part pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Two bounded, non-bottoming stops with retained setting vs part placed in tray only after the wheel fully stops.
comparison.reason: Both include safe sequencing around machinery, but the central tested abilities—mechanical tuning versus run-down waiting—are meaningfully different.
